name: Tensaro Lab
tagline: Move better. Prove it in degrees.
positioning: Tensaro Lab is the mobility and recovery studio for people who train seriously, turning range, load and recovery into numbers you can track instead of feelings you have to guess.
audience: Recreational and amateur athletes aged 25-45, desk-bound lifters and runners, and small coaching teams who want measurable, structured mobility and recovery work.
strategy: Own the 'measured mobility' space with a clinical, lab-report identity that makes progress visible: every piece of content shows a reading, a method or a protocol. Social leans on annotated diagrams and data callouts for credibility and saves, while community formats (Open Lab Saturdays) convert followers into in-person baseline screens.

contrastPairs.use: links and mono eyebrows on light

designSystem.spacing: 8px base unit; 24px grid gutters; sections at 96-128px vertical rhythm on desktop, 64px on mobile
designSystem.radius: Tight and instrument-like: 4px for labels and cards, 10px for panels, full pill only for primary CTAs
designSystem.borders: 1-2px solid Lab Ink hairlines; 1px #C9D6DF grid rules; dashed lines reserved for reference/target positions
designSystem.imagery: No photography. Original annotated diagrams: joint-angle figures, goniometers, protractor arcs and floor plans on technical grid paper
designSystem.shapes: Straight segments with round caps for limbs, ringed circles for joints with a coral centre marker, corner crop marks around key panels
designSystem.buttons: Primary: Instrument Blue pill with white label; secondary: outlined ink rectangle with mono label; accent: coral pill with ink label
designSystem.cards: White specimen cards with 2px ink border, teal left tab, mono key label above a Space Grotesk value
designSystem.motifs: Measurement ticks and rulers, joint-angle diagrams, data callouts with leader lines, technical grid paper, specimen labels (SPEC. 04-A, FIG. 01)

artDirection: Every creative reads like a page from a lab report: grid paper or ink field, one annotated diagram as hero, and data callouts connected by thin leader lines. Hierarchy runs mono eyebrow, then a Space Grotesk headline, then one plain sentence, then a single CTA. Coral is a marker, never a fill for large areas; it points to the reading that matters. Any numbers are clearly labelled as sample or illustrative, and wellness copy stays educational with no medical claims.
